text.en: Pet owners consistently praise the staff at Karenswood for their attentive, welcoming, and knowledgeable approach to canine boarding. Long-standing clients note that the team manages dogs with confidence and kindness, making both first-time guests and returning visitors feel safe and thoroughly cared for throughout their stay.

Reviewers emphasize that dogs are treated with great warmth and personal attention during boarding. Owners of active breeds and larger dogs, including XL Bullies, report that their pets are settled comfortably, handled gently, and provided with plenty of exercise and companionship while families are away.

Multiple clients comment that their dogs return home in excellent spirits, healthy, and pleasantly tired from daily activities and outdoor exercise. Owners express reassurance in seeing how eager and cheerful their pets remain after boarding, reinforcing their trust in the facility for future holidays.

q.en: Are larger breeds and powerful dogs accepted for boarding?

a.en: Reviewers report positive boarding stays for larger dogs, including XL Bullies, noting that staff handle them comfortably and safely.

q.en: How do dogs typically respond after their stay at Karenswood?

a.en: Clients consistently mention that their pets come home happy, energetic, and healthy after enjoying outdoor exercise and playtime.

q.en: Is Karenswood suitable for long-term or repeat boarding?

a.en: Several pet owners note that they have trusted the kennels for many years, frequently booking repeat stays during family holidays.
